// diagnostic

E1260

An exported function has an unsupported signature.

What

An exported function has an unsupported signature.

Why

A sandbox `pub fn` crosses the Component boundary: each parameter and the result must be `Int`, `Float`, `Bool`, `Text`, or a recursively closed `#Codable` record/list/Option/Result shape, mixed freely across positions. A native Library `#Export(c)` function crosses the C boundary: each parameter and the result must be one C primitive (`Int`, `Float`, `Bool`, `Text`, or a fixed width such as `U8` or `F32`), independently per position.

Fix

Change each unsupported parameter or result to a shape its boundary carries, or drop `pub` (sandbox) or `#Export(c)` (Library) if the function isn't meant to cross the boundary.
